CVE-2026-24049.5389c25cf4a1ee11ea55183d6daf4c8055dc3060:
Add wheel-0.47.0 to seed packages as mitigation of CVE-2026-24049 (#3167)

Hi!

Me and my team ran into the issue that even with the latest version of
`virtualenv` each venv gets seeded with `wheel 0.45.1`, which is
vulnerable in terms of
[CVE-2026-24049](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-24049).
This PR adds the most current version of the `wheel` package to the list
of seeding packages at the time this PR was authored.
